paper: M. T. Sharbati et al., Low-Power, Electrochemically Tunable Graphene Synapses for Neuromorphic Computing, Adv. Mater. 30, 1802353 (2018)
page_convention: page N of the 6-page article (printed '1802353 (N of 6)'); the Supporting Information is not available locally

role_definitions.calibration: the model defaults were tuned to (or derived directly from) this number - agreement is a consistency check, not a prediction
role_definitions.held-out: not used when the defaults were set - agreement is evidence

held_out_summary: NONE. Every text scalar below was used to set a default of model_v2.py / model_v3.py (and the matching .va), or follows directly from one that was (step % from the -10 ohm settled step).
tolerance_note: The paper gives no error bars for any of these numbers. tolerance is null everywhere; tolerance_basis states the reported precision. The score table prints the relative error and leaves the judgement to the reader; inequality targets print met / not met.

targets.quantity: single potentiation pulse: instantaneous resistance change
targets.tolerance_basis: reported precision: '~30 ohm' (2 significant figures), no error bar
targets.calibrated_by: v2 n_states, Q_ref; v3 Q_full, kappa_v
targets.extraction: min R in the 1 s after the 50 pA / 10 ms onset minus R at the onset

targets.quantity: single potentiation pulse: instantaneous resistance change, relative
targets.extraction: 100 * dR_peak / R0. Note -30 ohm / 0.67 % implies R0 ~ 4.48 kOhm; the Fig. 3a axis shows R0 ~ 4410 ohm; the models use Rinit = 4400 ohm

targets.quantity: single potentiation pulse: settled change, read inside the figure window
targets.tolerance_basis: reported precision: '-10 ohm' (1-2 significant figures); 'gradually diminished to a stable value'
targets.calibrated_by: v2 kappa_v, pool weights; v3 kappa_v, pool weights
targets.extraction: R(onset + 35 s) - R0 (the figure ends ~35 s after the pulse)

targets.quantity: single potentiation pulse: settled change, asymptote
single potentiation pulse: settled change, relative
single depression pulse: instantaneous resistance change
targets.tolerance_basis: reported precision: '+30 ohm', no error bar
targets.calibrated_by: v2 kappa_d, nu_d; v3 symmetric by construction (same Q_full, kappa_v)
targets.extraction: max R in the 1 s after the -50 pA / 10 ms onset minus R at the onset

targets.quantity: single depression pulse: settled change, read inside the figure window
single depression pulse: settled change, asymptote

targets.tolerance_basis: reported precision: 22 ms ('~22 ms' in the caption)
targets.calibrated_by: w, D (tau1 = w^2/2D = 22.2 ms) in both models
targets.extraction: free 6-parameter fit of the paper form dG = sum c_i exp(-dt/tau_i) (no offset) to dG = peak2 - peak1 over the 14 onset-to-onset dt from 15 to 1800 ms

targets.calibrated_by: l, D (tau2 = l^2/2D = 312.5 ms) in both models

targets.tolerance_basis: reported precision: 19 s; weakly identified from dt <= 1.8 s (exp(-1.8/19) = 0.91)
targets.page_figure: p.4 text; Fig. 4b; fit detail in Fig. S7 (SI missing)

targets.quantity: LTP linearity: R^2 of a linear fit between 10 % and 90 % lithiation
targets.extraction: LTP reads (G at the end of each 50 ms period); straight-line fit vs pulse index over the reads inside 10-90 % of the ramp's own G range

targets.quantity: distinct nonvolatile states with 50 pA / 10 ms pulses
targets.page_figure: p.4 text; Fig. 3c caption; abstract p.1
targets.extraction: LTP reads that rise above the previous read by > 1 % of the median 10-90 % step

targets.tolerance_basis: inequality as reported ('<0.4 %'); must refer to the settled step since the instantaneous step is 0.67 %
targets.calibrated_by: follows from the calibrated -10 ohm settled step
targets.extraction: 100 * |dR_asym| / R0 of the single potentiation pulse

targets.quantity: conductance change after a 13 h hold under 0.1 V read
targets.tolerance_basis: reported precision: 3.2 %; held state unknown (Fig. S5 missing)
targets.calibrated_by: v2 tau_retention = 1.31e6 s; v3 tau_ret = 1.05e6 s
targets.extraction: 100 * (G(300 s + 13 h) - G(300 s)) / G(300 s), after one +50 pA / 10 ms pulse from R0 = Rinit; the model read bias (10 mV) does not affect the state

targets.quantity: modulation of channel resistance vs Li content
targets.tolerance_basis: reported precision: '~700 %'; definition assumed (Gmax - Gmin)/Gmin = Rmax/Rmin - 1; Fig. 2d is a DC measurement over full lithiation
targets.extraction: 100 * (max G - min G) / min G over the LTP/LTD run (both rails reached)

curve_slots.x: pulse index from the start of one LTP ramp
time since the start of the hold
